label: SCAN
description: Brute-force attack. High damage, fast cooldown, but spikes digital trace massively.

label: BYPASS
description: Surgical strike. Steady damage, low trace, but slowly builds physical heat.

label: PULSE
description: Scramble signatures. Drops trace drastically, but fries your rig (massive heat spike).

label: DECRYPT
description: Crack encrypted logs. Unmasks firewall health, but requires intense local processing.
